title: Dig 77 - Port
description: Port, behind the fence on the eastern side. Enter Secure warehouse 1 area through the sewers, open the gate and bring a Forklift. If you haven't move the security camera, drive behind the warehouse building to avoid detection. There's a stack of bricks to the left of the warehouse building. Use the Forklift to move it away and reveal the hole in the fence. Crawl through it, go right and then down along the fence, and you will reach the dig spot. While you can reach the spot area while working in secure cargo loading/unloading task, you cannot dig it up while working.

title: Dig 78 - Port
description: Port, in the forest behind the Fox Shop. Go north from the shop entrance, then follow a path through the forest east and south. There may be a minor glitch that digging this spot teleports you through the forest to the road.

title: Dig 79 - Port sewers
description: Port Sewers, in a walled area in the northwest. This place can be reached from Secure Warehouse 3 underground, only reachable in and after Storyline chapter 4. The lockers here contain a key to the door, so you can use this place as a shortcut.

title: Dig 80 - Pemberton Hideout
description: Pemberton Hideout, behind Pancake Mix crates. Reach the Forklift and use it to remove the crates blocking the way to the corridor. Quickly drive east: the camera will trigger Ranger Danger, but entering another area removes it. Drive back into the corridor to the south and use the forklift to move away the crates blocking access to the dig spot. This spot contains a Gold Bar.
